title: Residue map with surjective kernel
statement: Under the hypotheses of lem-weil-pbc-strict-henselization-pointed-map, there exists a ring homomorphism from the strict henselization ring to the relative separable closure which is surjective and whose kernel is the maximal ideal.

proof.text: Choose an affine open containing the image of the geometric point and factor the geometric point through its open immersion. Apply the neighbourhood/triple comparison. Its colimit isomorphism, the small-model equivalence and the affine inclusion equivalence identify the chosen strict henselization ring with the triple colimit.

Apply the strict henselization triple theorem to the chart and its relative separable closure, obtaining its colimit and surjective residue map. Uniqueness of colimits gives the remaining ring isomorphism. Compose the surjective residue map with this ring isomorphism.

The open immersion induces an isomorphism of residue fields (Mathlib Scheme.Hom.residueFieldMap). Pull back the algebra structure on the chart separable closure along this isomorphism. Mathlib Algebra.IsSeparable.of_equiv_equiv transports separability; separable closedness is unchanged. Mathlib IsSepClosure.equiv gives an abstract equivalence with the specified relative separable closure. Compose the preceding surjection with it. This core assertion makes no pointedness claim and does not need the embedding compatibility hypothesis hΩ.

The composite is surjective since each ring isomorphism is bijective. Mathlib IsLocalRing.ker_eq_maximalIdeal identifies its kernel with the maximal ideal for the local-ring instance in the statement.

proof_origin.place: Tag 04HX, with algebra.tex Tags 04GW and 04GP; colimit comparison followed by abstract equivalence of separable closures for the existential core

lean.statement: theorem strictHenselizationPointedMap_core {Y : Scheme.{v}} {Ω : Type v} [Field Ω] [IsAlgClosed Ω] (barY : Spec (.of Ω) ⟶ Y) [Algebra (Y.residueField (barY (IsLocalRing.closedPoint Ω))) Ω] (hΩ : algebraMap (Y.residueField (barY (IsLocalRing.closedPoint Ω))) Ω = (Scheme.descResidueField (Scheme.stalkClosedPointTo barY)).hom) [IsLocalRing (Scheme.strictHenselizationRing barY)] : ∃ ψ : Scheme.strictHenselizationRing barY →+* separableClosure (Y.residueField (barY (IsLocalRing.closedPoint Ω))) Ω, Function.Surjective ψ ∧ RingHom.ker ψ = IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (Scheme.strictHenselizationRing barY)
